meta.parties: De Livera Et Al. v. Abeysinghe Et Al

rules.statement: A decree from which an appeal lies and has in fact been taken is not res judicata between the parties.
rules.supporting_quote: This effect arises from section 207 of the Civil Procedure Code. In India it has been held that where the decision of a lower Court is appealed to a superior tribunal which for any reason does not think fit to decide the matter, the question is left open and is not res judicata.
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: section 207 of the Civil Procedure Code
